rating_schema.critical_incidents: list <=128 of exact incident_id/type/evidence_sha256/description; duplicate IDs rejected, no semantic harmonization
rating_schema.incident_id: bounded opaque identifier, emitted only as SHA
rating_schema.reviewer_reference_sha256: lowercase64hex or null; never authenticates a person

api.raw_byte_policy: original bytes are SHA-bound exactly without reencoding; caller retains raw externally
api.return: allowlisted hashes/types/declarations/scores/declared_component_total/incidents; every human, identity, independence, blinding, chronology, custody and evidence verification false
api.signature: validate_development_rating(rating_raw:bytes, *, rating_sha256:str, blinded_delivery_raw:bytes, blinded_delivery_sha256:str, rubric_raw:bytes, rubric_sha256:str, delivery_contract_raw:bytes, delivery_contract_sha256:str)->dict

limitations: synthetic test ratings only, no actual human evaluations supplied or generated
no file IO, external sources, provider calls, keys, case packages, reserve or production access in the API
opaque delivery content and actual blinding are not verified
evidence digests have no semantic proof, custody or chronology verification
component total is arithmetic over supplied integer components, not verified Q
incidents remain separate and are not compensated by component scores
no DEV acceptance/rejection rule or required judge count is introduced
confirmatory two-judge/arbitration rules are not applied to DEV
